ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached images show triangle DEF with D at the top, E at the lower left, and F at the lower right. The slanted sides DE and DF each have a matching tick mark, indicating DE = DF. The angle at D is labeled 42°. The angle at F is labeled (4x + 11)°. The base EF is labeled 2x - 3. Reasoning: Since DE = DF, triangle DEF is isosceles with base EF, so the base angles at E and F are congruent. The two base angles sum to 180° - 42° = 138°, so each base angle is 138° / 2 = 69°. The angle at F is labeled 4x + 11, so 4x + 11 = 69. Then 4x = 58, so x = 14.5. The length EF is labeled 2x - 3, so EF = 2(14.5) - 3 = 29 - 3 = 26.
